text:
Nvidia's market value crossed $4 trillion on July 9, 2025, driven by sustained demand for its Blackwell accelerator rack systems (GB200/GB300), the ~$500 billion Stargate AI-infrastructure plan, and repeated upward revisions to capital expenditure guidance from major hyperscalers including Microsoft, Meta, Google, and Amazon throughout 2025 [Source: ev-1].

This milestone indicates that the market is pricing AI infrastructure as the largest new capital cycle since the internet era, with Nvidia positioned as a central "toll-booth" in this spending supercycle [Source: ev-1].
